title: Keycloak Realm Config Extras
description: Sibling to deploy/keycloak/realm-config.json. Carries per-resource PDP-unavailable fallback rules used by the TypeScript and Python middleware. Resources not listed here implicitly deny all when the PDP is unreachable.

pdp_unavailable_fallback.description: Map of Keycloak resource name -> fallback rule. Keys MUST match a resource defined in realm-config.json (cross-validated by scripts/validate-realm-config.py).

mode.description: Reject all requests when the PDP is unreachable. The default for resources not listed in this file.
Allow the request if the bearer's realm_access.roles claim contains the named role; otherwise deny.

role.description: Realm role name. MUST exist in realm-config.json.
